notes:
Spinners are such a fun component to play with. Some use nine cells, some sixteen, with a few different animations and interactions. There’s surprisingly much you can do with such a simple shape. Really fun to experiment with.

Designer: @wherescz. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
